verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only building blocks for reconciliation. Per-user wallets hold and split funds (implying per-seller balances), webhooks push event notifications for API objects, platform fees are wired monthly, and an OpenAPI spec exists. Nothing documents settlement or balance reports, roll-ups, file exports, or scheduled delivery to a finance stack. Missing for 10: settlement/reconciliation report endpoints or files, per-seller and rolled-up report coverage, scheduled report delivery, explicit wallet balance API docs, independent corroboration.
